visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three individuals are seated on a plush gray sofa against a neutral, off-white interior wall background. On the left, a young woman with short dark hair wears a brown cardigan over a black top; in the center, a young man has light ash-blonde hair and wears a sage green short-sleeved button-up shirt; on the right, a young man with dark hair wears a black utility vest over a white t-shirt. They are all looking towards the camera, smiling brightly, and performing a synchronized hand-clapping routine where they alternate between clapping their own palms together and patting their thighs in a steady rhythm. (2) The scene cuts through several rounds of their game, with the central male character occasionally wearing a blue-and-white patterned denim jacket instead of the green shirt. Their facial expressions are highly animated, switching from concentrated focus during the rhythmic wordplay to wide-mouthed laughter and surprised looks when someone makes a mistake. Hand gestures are repetitive and crisp, maintaining the beat, while the background remains a consistent, well-lit studio-like living room setting with no other moving objects visible. (3) Towards the end of the clip, the physical reactions become more exaggerated. The woman claps her hands to her cheeks while laughing, and the man on the right leans his torso forward and then back against the sofa cushions in amusement. Large variety-show style text overlays in black and white boxes appear at the top of the frame, and colorful pink flame graphics occasionally pulse around the edges of the screen during moments of high excitement. The lighting remains bright and even, highlighting the clear skin textures and fabric details of the participants.
